## Document change

What changes, and why? Identify changed line-item IDs and explain amounts and justification.

## Review

- [ ] The JSON check passes.
- [ ] Source amounts and hypothetical changes are distinguished.
- [ ] Funding assumptions and unresolved questions are documented.
- [ ] Review threads are resolved.

**Merging means approval of this document version.**

Use the fiscal-year working branch to propose changes to its approved branch. Use a draft PR for work in progress.
